q: Is potash from Jordan covered by CBAM?
title: Jordanian potash: CBAM check
short: No. Potassium chloride sits under CN 3104, which is not on the CBAM list, so EU imports carry no CBAM obligation. Buyers may still ask for a footprint per tonne, built from the energy used in evaporation, refining and drying at the Dead Sea works.
audience: Potash producers in Jordan and EU fertiliser blenders and distributors

ul: Mixed fertilisers with nitrogen under 3105: covered.

p: A blend that contains nitrogen falls under 3105 and is covered, including its potash share. Check the CN code of what is actually shipped.
Fuel and power per tonne, and freight to the port. Buyers use it for their Scope 3.
